8.3.4.1.11 Dem_SetFreezeFrameRecordFilter
[SWS_Dem_00209] Definition of API function Dem_SetFreezeFrameRecordFilter
⌈
Service Name
Dem_SetFreezeFrameRecordFilter
Syntax
Std_ReturnType Dem_SetFreezeFrameRecordFilter (
uint8 ClientId,
Dem_DTCFormatType DTCFormat
)
Service ID [hex]
0x3f
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant for different ClientIds, non reentrant for the same ClientId.
ClientId
Unique client id, assigned to the instance of the calling module.
Parameters (in)
DTCFormat
Defines the output-format of the requested DTC values
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
Std_ReturnType
Status of the operation to (re-)set a freeze frame record filter.
E_OK: Filter is accepted
E_NOT_OK: Wrong filter selected
Description
Sets a freeze frame record filter.
Available via
Dem.h
⌋
